best_section.where: along the Toowong Memorial Park fence, between the roundabout/zebra crossing and the sharp rise further east

drivers.road: Tertiary road, 60 km/h, two lanes plus turn lanes, zebra crossing and a roundabout at the western end — a through route, not a quiet street.
drivers.room_and_convention: No parked cars anywhere along the kerb line itself; the only marked bays sit inside the roundabout splitter near the start, not usable. No kerbside parking convention on this stretch.
drivers.houses: Park and oval on the kerb side; houses sit across the wide multi-lane road, which buffers them, but the road itself still rules this out.

flags: Steep: grade climbs to about 15.6% over the final ~40 m of the kerb (chunk 2 east end)
Busy 60 km/h through road with turn lanes and a zebra crossing/roundabout — traffic noise likely all evening
sun_shade: Large trees along the park/oval side (south of the road) overhang most of the best section, giving shade through the day; the open oval further east gets more direct sun.
cannot_judge: Street lighting brightness at night (tagged lit=yes but not visible in overhead imagery)
Noise level from the park/oval at night (events, early sports use)
summary: A busy 60 km/h through road with no parking convention anywhere along the kerb.
